title.narrative: Strengthening the resilience of village communities through the development of sustainable livelihoods and the protection of natural resources
Stärkung der Resilienz von Dorfgemeinschaften durch die Entwicklung nachhaltiger Lebensgrundlagen und den Schutz natürlicher Ressourcen

description.narrative: Die autochthone Bevölkerung in Indonesien sieht sich der zunehmenden Zerstörung ihrer Lebensgrundlagen z. B. durch Entwaldung für Palmölplantagen und Minenabbau ausgesetzt. The indigenous population in Indonesia is facing the increasing destruction of their livelihoods, e.g. through deforestation for palm oil plantations and mining. Through joint actions to strengthen their rights and culture, through sustainable use of natural resources and effective protection against disasters, the resilience of the communities is to be strengthened and economic and ecological injustice countered.
